theme_strategy: Dual-surface strategy: Swiss Brutalism/High-Contrast for Marketing (Surface A) + Tactile Minimalism (Linear/Stripe) for Dashboard (Surface B). System supports Light/Dark mode and LTR/RTL.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (generic centered layouts, uniform gradients). Implement heavy whitespace (2-3x typical), layered depths, glass-morphism (12-24px blur) where appropriate. CRITICAL: Never use a fully transparent background beneath text/content, such as in dropdowns or sticky headers. Ensure robust focus states. Do NOT apply universal 'transition: all' to prevent transform bugs. Do not center-align the main app container. Add rich micro-interactions on hover and click states.

typography.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule. Mixing distinctive editorial weights with highly legible dashboard sans.

fonts.marketing_heading: Cabinet Grotesk (High impact, wide, geometric, tight tracking)
fonts.metrics_and_code: JetBrains Mono (Clear tabular numbers, coding aesthetic)
fonts.rtl_arabic: Cairo or Tajawal (Modern geometric Arabic support)

scales.h1_hero: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-[1.1]

surfaces.card: bg-card border border-border shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

layouts_and_grids.spacing_scale: px-4 py-6 for cards (Stripe pattern); gap-8 to gap-12 between sections; py-20 to py-32 for marketing sections.

dashboard_layout.sidebar: Collapsible left-sidebar (240px expanded). Contains tenant workspace switcher at top.
dashboard_layout.content: Max-width 1280px (for data tables/charts) with px-6 py-8.

marketing_layout.bento_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 with asymmetric spans (e.g., col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero feature, col-span-4 for secondary).

layouts_and_grids.rtl_support: Use logical CSS properties exclusively (e.g., ms-4 instead of ml-4, ps-6 instead of pl-6, start/end instead of left/right).

component_guidelines.kpi_card: Minimalist layout (200-280px wide). Icon (top-left) + Metric Value (text-3xl font-mono) + Sparkline (Recharts tiny line chart) + Subtext (text-sm text-muted-foreground).
component_guidelines.data_table: Stripe-inspired. No vertical borders. Subtle horizontal borders (border-b border-border). Hover state (hover:bg-muted/50). Compact row height (h-12). Avatar + Name side-by-side for users.
component_guidelines.tenant_switcher: Dropdown menu at the top of the sidebar. Shows active tenant logo, name, and 'Free/Pro' badge. Includes 'Create New Workspace' action.
component_guidelines.command_palette: Linear-style ⌘K. Centered modal, glassmorphism overlay. Quick actions for 'Go to Students', 'Mark Attendance', 'New Invoice'.
component_guidelines.timetable_calendar: CSS Grid based weekly view. Drag-and-drop slots. Use distinct pastel/soft colors for different course types to avoid visual fatigue.
component_guidelines.attendance_ui: Fast toggle UI for 'Present/Absent/Late/Excused' (Segmented Control style). Not dropdowns.
component_guidelines.status_badges: Pill-shaped, transparent background with 10% opacity, crisp text. (e.g., bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 font-medium text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full).
component_guidelines.marketing_hero: Text-heavy left side (Cabinet Grotesk H1, loose body text), bold Primary CTA + Secondary Outline CTA. Right side features an abstract 3D element or high-contrast app screenshot floating.

motion.page_transitions: opacity-0 to opacity-100, translate-y-4 to translate-y-0 duration-300
motion.staggered_lists: Use framer-motion variants to stagger data table rows or KPI cards (delay 0.05s per item).
motion.reduced_motion: Wrap animations in checks for prefers-reduced-motion media query.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links). Use kebab-case role-based names (e.g., 'login-submit-button', 'tenant-switcher-trigger', 'student-row-action').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio for standard text. Never use pure #000000, tint it slightly (#0A0A0B).
accessibility_and_testing.aria: Use aria-hidden='true' for purely decorative icons. Ensure dialogs have aria-labelledby.

media_and_3d.charts: Recharts for dashboard metrics. Prioritize clear LineCharts for revenue trends and BarCharts for enrollments. No unnecessary animations on charts.
media_and_3d.marketing_3d: For the landing page hero, consider React Three Fiber (R3F) or Spline for an interactive, abstract educational globe or floating geometric shapes.

landing_hero_bg.description: Minimalist architecture photography to use as an abstract background or hero visual.

feature_collaboration.description: Group of students collaborating. Great for the 'Student Management' feature block.

testimonial_teacher.description: Professional smiling woman, use for testimonials or a generic teacher profile avatar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize building the UI using standard React (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
In the Tailwind config, include Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono.
Implement the Dual-surface strategy: Make the marketing site look highly editorial and asymmetrical, while keeping the ERP dashboard heavily structured, dense, and grid-based (Linear/Stripe style).
Ensure RTL support by using logical CSS properties (ms-, me-, ps-, pe-) rather than physical ones (ml-, mr-, pl-, pr-).
Implement Sonner for toast notifications and customize Shadcn components to remove the 'default Vercel look'.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Never place text over images without a sufficient overlay (e.g., bg-black/50), and never use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or modals.
